checks.statement: **Manual path survives failure.** Every experimental or agent-driven feature leaves an always-reachable manual route to Settings and to each top-level destination, with the feature forced off
checks.measure: a boot-disable path exists *and* a visible control reaches Settings with the feature on
checks.threshold: any state where the feature failing removes navigation

checks.statement: **Progress past 10 s.** Any agent action >10 s renders determinate per-stage progress, not an indeterminate spinner
checks.measure: stage list with completed/current state, or a %/count

checks.statement: **Disclosure depth ≤3.** Front face → detail → opt-in generated narrative. No fourth required rung
checks.measure: task completable at level 1

checks.statement: **Correction path.** Every agent-authored artifact can be *amended*, not only accepted or rejected
checks.measure: an edit/steer verb reaching the same artifact

checks.statement: **Confirms stay rare.** Second confirmation only for irreversible or R2/R3 actions, and it names the blast radius
checks.measure: ≤1 confirm per decision path; blast radius named
checks.threshold: a generic "Are you sure?", or a confirm on a reversible action

checks.statement: **Interruption budget.** Every notifier passes one policy object (urgency tier, quiet hours, daily cap, batch window); nothing sends direct
checks.measure: all send paths route through the policy

checks.statement: **Primary content readable with secondary controls collapsed.** Answer forms, asks, and other secondary UI default to collapsed and never cover the content being read; list/card views never render inputs
checks.measure: viewer content height ≥70% of viewport by default; expansion only on explicit tap; no inputs rendered in list views
checks.threshold: secondary UI open by default, covering the content, or any input rendered in a list/card view
checks.source: S11 (added from the M34 r2 hotfix, 2026-09-14)

checks.statement: **Undo or consent for agent-initiated action.**
checks.measure: Every agent-initiated action at risk tier ≥R1 exposes either a reachable undo affordance after the action, or an explicit pre-action consent gate before it — never neither.
checks.threshold: an R1+ agent action with no undo control and no prior consent gate (today: the auto-ship deploy step has neither).

checks.statement: **Closed token vocabulary.** No raw colour/spacing literal outside the generated token file
checks.measure: 0 raw hex / `rgb()` / off-scale spacing in component CSS

checks.statement: **Spacing on the 4/8 scale**; type sizes and line-heights from tokens
checks.measure: every value in {4,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64} or a token

checks.statement: **Measure 45–75 CPL** for any body prose (card bullets, briefs, transcripts) at 393 px
checks.measure: rendered line length 45–75 characters

checks.statement: **Motion inside the band.** Feedback transitions 150–500 ms (vault tokens); environmental motion ≤12 % luminance, ≤0.02 px/frame
checks.measure: all durations from tokens; ambient within the R2 grant
checks.threshold: <100 ms, >500 ms for feedback, or ambient over budget

checks.statement: **First-frame legibility.** The 50 ms frame (first paint, pre-settle) is judged, not only the settled state
checks.measure: first-paint capture reads as the intended surface

checks.statement: **Complexity default.** Any high-density surface (graph, terrain) ships a ruled low-complexity default state
checks.measure: named default with a stated element budget

checks.statement: **Anti-slop.** None of: Inter/system-sans as the display face, purple→blue gradient, uniform rounded-card kit, fade-up-on-scroll everywhere, a nameable silhouette standing in for atmosphere
checks.measure: zero tells

checks.statement: **Render matches reference, pairwise.** Side by side at equal visual size against the ratified reference row; colour and position are the known-weak axes
checks.measure: shape language, edge, contrast, speed, layering, tint, typography all match the recipe's parameters
checks.threshold: any axis outside the recipe card's stated numbers

checks.statement: **Confirmation tiered by stakes × confidence.** No routing without a human-visible final text above the stakes threshold (`ingest-source` is the only exception)
checks.measure: tier declared per pipeline and enforced
checks.threshold: any high-stakes route with no visible final text

checks.statement: **Lossless means lossless.** `clean`/`condense` add no claim; anything that rephrases is a diff the human accepts
checks.measure: diff shown; no sentence present in output absent from input
checks.threshold: an unaccepted rewrite, or an added claim

checks.statement: **Keyboard twin.** Every voice path has a first-class typed equivalent, and the app never nudges toward the mic
checks.measure: typed path equally reachable

checks.statement: **Stated latency budget.** Each pipeline declares an envelope; the surface shows per-node progress rather than implying conversational turn-taking
checks.measure: envelope declared and rendered
checks.threshold: undeclared, or a bare spinner past 2 s

checks.statement: **Confidence beside consequence.** Every agent-authored artifact renders a certainty signal alongside its risk tier
checks.measure: both fields present and distinguishable

checks.statement: **No naked explanation.** A generated explanation ("brief me", advisor output) never renders without a confidence and at least one disconfirming cue
checks.measure: both present

checks.statement: **Capability + limits stated.** One reachable surface states what the system can do and how often it is wrong, in plain language
checks.measure: present and current

checks.statement: **Change notice.** Any behaviour change the human did not request — a promoted pipeline default, an auto-shipped diff, a deployed build — is announced with what changed and a revert path
checks.measure: notice + revert

checks.statement: target size
checks.measure: every interactive element ≥44×44 px with ≥8 px between adjacent small targets (vault standard, above WCAG 2.5.8's 24×24 AA floor)

checks.statement: contrast from pixels
checks.measure: body text ≥4.5:1, large text and every meaningful non-text graphic ≥3:1, recomputed from the rendered composite in each state combination the component can enter, including aria-current/selected/disabled overlays

checks.statement: reduced motion
checks.measure: under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the surface is DOM- or pixel-identical across a 10 s idle window, and no state change is communicated by motion alone
checks.threshold: FIX if motion persists or state communicated by motion alone

checks.statement: single-pointer + screen-reader
checks.measure: every drag/swipe has a tap equivalent that is reachable in focus order with a screen reader running, no state is signalled by hue alone, and no internal code (R2, H-DECIDE, a gate id) renders unglossed
checks.threshold: FIX if any drag without tap equivalent, hue-only state, or unglossed internal code
